items.title: Downgrade FACT claims citing INFERENCE evidence to INFERENCE/UNKNOWN
items.problem: StructuredOutputValidator treats all valid evidence IDs identically, allowing a model claim classified as FACT to be approved even when the underlying evidence is classified as INFERENCE.
items.rootCause: validEvidenceIds Set in StructuredOutputValidator lumped FACT and INFERENCE evidence IDs together without checking classification mapping.
items.proposedSolution: Maintain distinct factEvidenceIds and inferenceEvidenceIds sets. If a claim claims FACT but only cites INFERENCE evidence IDs, downgrade the claim classification to INFERENCE and log the intervention.
items.expectedBenefit: Guarantees strict epistemological boundary: inferences can never be passed off as confirmed facts.
items.possibleRegressionRisk: Low. Does not affect legitimate FACT claims backed by verified FACT edges.
items.automatedTestRequired: ai-engine/validators/structuredOutputValidator test verifying FACT claim citing INFERENCE evidence is downgraded.

items.title: Enforce repository snapshot cutoff timestamp in WhyExplorerService
items.problem: WhyExplorerService does not check or respect the pinned repository snapshot timestamp, allowing post-snapshot commits and issues to enter the historical reasoning chain.
items.rootCause: WhyExplorerService.executeQuery was unaware of the repository snapshot timestamp and did not filter connected edges or nodes by snapshot cutoff.
items.proposedSolution: Retrieve the repository's pinned snapshot timestamp from RepositoryController. Filter out candidate edges and nodes whose timestamps occur after the snapshot timestamp.
items.expectedBenefit: Prevents post-snapshot violations and ensures strict compliance with pinned benchmark repository states.
items.possibleRegressionRisk: Low. Only excludes events occurring after the pinned snapshot.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying that post-snapshot events are excluded from the historical reasoning chain.

items.title: Prioritize historical chain traversal in GraphQueryEngine.getHistoricalChain
items.problem: GraphQueryEngine.getHistoricalChain states in documentation that it walks File -> Commit -> PR -> Issue, but implementation used edges.find() taking the first connected edge regardless of type.
items.rootCause: Missing relationship and node type priority sorting in getHistoricalChain.
items.proposedSolution: Sort and filter candidate edges prioritizing MODIFIED/CHANGED -> IMPLEMENTED/MERGED -> RESOLVES/REFERENCES, and target node types COMMIT -> PULL_REQUEST -> ISSUE.
items.expectedBenefit: Produces predictable, canonical historical reasoning chains rather than jumping to unrelated nodes.
items.possibleRegressionRisk: Low. Conforms to the original documented architectural design.
items.automatedTestRequired: Regression test verifying canonical chain traversal across mixed edge types.

items.title: Fix relationship direction for EXPOSES in ImpactAnalysisService
items.problem: When analyzing impact of removing a file, functions or components exported by that file via EXPOSES edges are omitted from affected components because EXPOSES was evaluated under currentFrontier.has(edge.target).
items.rootCause: RelationshipRegistry defines EXPOSES as File -> Function/Component. ImpactAnalysisService failed to include EXPOSES in the forward container branch (relType === 'CONTAINS' || relType === 'DECLARES').
items.proposedSolution: Add 'EXPOSES' to the forward container relationship check: (relType === 'CONTAINS' || relType === 'DECLARES' || relType === 'EXPOSES') when currentFrontier contains the source node.
items.expectedBenefit: Accurate blast radius calculation: removing a source file accurately marks its exposed functions/components as affected.
items.possibleRegressionRisk: Low. Directly aligns with RelationshipRegistry semantics.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying file with EXPOSES edge propagates impact to exposed functions.

items.title: Fix repositoryId placeholder in WhyExplorerService evidence records
items.problem: WhyExplorerService sets evidence.repositoryId to targetNode.id (e.g. file:EEID-REPO-001:lib/app.js) instead of the canonical repository ID, requiring hacky workarounds in ChatController.
items.rootCause: categorizeEvidence in WhyExplorerService used targetNode.id for evidence.repositoryId.
items.proposedSolution: Pass canonical repository ID into categorizeEvidence and assign evidence.repositoryId = repositoryId.
items.expectedBenefit: Clean, consistent evidence records adhering to repository isolation without downstream patching.
items.possibleRegressionRisk: Very low. Preserves canonical repository IDs.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying all generated evidence records carry the repository ID.

items.title: Support function and component node IDs in cleanNodeFilePath
items.problem: cleanNodeFilePath only stripped 'file:' prefixes, failing when queried with function or component node IDs like 'function:EEID-REPO-001:lib/application.js:app.listen:60'.
items.rootCause: cleanNodeFilePath regex only handled /^file:[^:]+:/ and did not handle other node types or trailing symbol/line specifiers.
items.proposedSolution: Enhance cleanNodeFilePath to recognize function: and component: prefixes, stripping repository and trailing symbol/line segments to extract the valid file path.
items.expectedBenefit: Enables retrieval of underlying source files when users or benchmark questions target function or component nodes.
items.possibleRegressionRisk: Very low. Strictly additive path normalization.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying source file retrieval for function node IDs.

items.title: Enforce exact repository matching precedence in repositoryController
items.problem: Substring includes matching in getSnapshot could prematurely match non-identical repository IDs (e.g., repo-1 matching repo-10).
items.rootCause: snap.metadata.id.toLowerCase().includes(cleanId) was executed in the same pass as alias matching.
items.proposedSolution: Perform exact key/id/alias matching in pass 1. Only evaluate substring match in pass 2 with segment boundary checks.
items.expectedBenefit: Zero repository confusion in multi-repository runtime environments.

items.title: Add request timeout to Gemini API fetch calls in ProviderService
items.problem: fetch calls to Generative Language REST API in ProviderService lacked an AbortController, creating risk of indefinite blocking during network degradation.
items.rootCause: Missing AbortController signal on fetch calls.
items.proposedSolution: Add an AbortController with configurable timeout (default 30,000ms), catching timeouts and cleanly falling back to local fallback.
items.expectedBenefit: Guarantees responsive server behavior even under provider network outages.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test validating timeout interception and fallback invocation.

items.title: Redact secrets in ChatController error response details
items.problem: ChatController catch block returned raw err?.message in details field without passing through redactSecrets.
items.rootCause: Unsanitized error details in 500 response payload.
items.proposedSolution: Wrap err?.message with redactSecrets before serializing into JSON response.
items.expectedBenefit: Prevents accidental leakage of API keys, URLs, or internal paths in HTTP error responses.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying that API tokens in error strings are redacted.

items.title: Add directed path traversal option to GraphQueryEngine.findPath
items.problem: findPath only supported undirected search, which can traverse backwards against directed dependencies.
items.rootCause: Adjacency list added forward and reverse edges unconditionally.
items.proposedSolution: Add optional options: { directed?: boolean } parameter (defaulting to false for full backward compatibility).
items.expectedBenefit: Enables strict caller-to-callee dependency path verification.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test comparing directed vs undirected path results on asymmetric graphs.

items.title: Version prompts and provide feature flag for pre-Task-6 baseline preservation
items.problem: Prompt strings were hardcoded in providerService.ts with no version identifier or flag to toggle between pre-Task-6 and enhanced versions.
items.rootCause: Absence of prompt versioning architecture in conversational chat pipeline.
items.proposedSolution: Create versioned prompt definitions: chat.v1 (exact pre-Task-6 prompt) and chat.v2 (Task 6 enhanced grounding prompt). Control via ENGITRACE_PROMPT_VERSION environment variable.
items.expectedBenefit: Preserves exact pre-Task-6 prompt for baseline evaluation while enabling versioned improvements.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying prompt switching between v1 and v2.

items.title: Expose explicit startLine and endLineExclusive in source line ranges
items.problem: lineRange in MultiFileContext only declared startLine and endLine without clarifying inclusive vs exclusive end line.
items.rootCause: Omission of explicit half-open interval field name.
items.proposedSolution: Expose both startLine (1-based inclusive) and endLineExclusive (1-based exclusive) alongside legacy endLine.
items.expectedBenefit: Unambiguous conformance to EEID 1-based start-inclusive end-exclusive source anchor convention.
items.automatedTestRequired: Test verifying source interval values adhere to half-open convention.
